Class ManagerRepository

java.lang.Object
ManagerRepository
public class ManagerRepository extends Object
Queries the manager screens need. Rows come back as Object[] in the column order of each query.

    • getProductUsage

      public List<Object[]> getProductUsage(LocalDate start, LocalDate end) throws SQLException
      Inventory used by paid orders between two dates, both inclusive: itemName, amountUsed, unit, quantityInStock. Counts the same amounts MenuRepository deducts at checkout, drink recipes plus customizations that use stock. Items nothing used are left out; the most-used item comes first.
      Parameters:
      start - the first day to include
      end - the last day to include
      Returns:
      one row per inventory item used in the window
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails

    • getXReport

      public List<Object[]> getXReport() throws SQLException
      X-report: today's sales activity per hour. Read-only, so it can be run as often as needed. One row per hour from opening (10 AM) through the current hour, plus any other hour with transactions, so quiet hours show as zeros: hour, orders, sales, discountedOrders, refunds, refundedAmount, cashSales, cardSales, applePaySales. Refunds count in the hour of the original sale.
      Returns:
      one row per hour, earliest first
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails
